response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned, polyglot engineer already holding a Staff Software Engineer title at an AI-agent infrastructure company, giving him direct exposure to the AI-native development mindset the role requires. He has solid distributed/high-throughput systems experience (Dunnhumby/Sociomantic, millions of requests/sec) and a strong software craftsmanship background. However, the complete absence of Python across his skills and 15+ years of history is a significant gap against an explicit must-have, and there's little concrete evidence of formal agile ceremonies, on-call/incident response ownership, or cross-functional stakeholder management at scale.
strengths: Current Staff-level role at re:cinq building AI-agent infrastructure, MCP tooling and agentic frameworks — directly aligned with the AI-native mindset required
Proven high-throughput distributed systems experience (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec, low-latency async I/O work at Dunnhumby)
Broad, deep technical breadth across many languages/paradigms and strong systems-thinking demonstrated via craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, open-source frameworks, workshops/talks)
concerns: No Python experience listed anywhere despite it being an explicit must-have skill
No clear evidence of formal on-call/incident-response ownership or operational monitoring responsibilities
Little explicit mention of Scrum/agile ceremony participation or structured stakeholder management across product/leadership functions

key_factors.factor: Current AI-native engineering role and agentic tooling experience
